paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: The performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance gain, in percent, on tasks achieved through predictive rollout search for different large vision-language models under strong and weak supervision. The horizontal axis displays the model names: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (%)” and presents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks every 5 units. Two bars are shown for each model, representing “Strong Supervision” in a darker purple hue, and “Weak Supervision” in a lighter purple hue. For GPT-4o, the “Strong Supervision” bar extends to approximately 24%, while the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 6%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the “Strong Supervision” bar extends to approximately 12%, and the “Weak Supervision” bar extends to approximately 26%. Finally, for Qwen2-72B-VL, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 22%, and the “Weak Supervision” bar extends to approximately 4%. The bars are arranged in pairs, with each pair visually representing the performance gain for a specific model under both supervision types, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
